source_record.title: Senior Project Developer (m/f/d)
source_record.description:
Your mission

  • Management of the project development cycle and external service providers such as architects and specialist planners up to the approval planning stage
  • Site assessments and preparation of feasibility studies, area planning and cost estimates for the planning and realization of commercial and residential projects
  • Negotiations with authorities, agencies, urban planners and stakeholders of the urban society
  • Support of urban planning workshop procedures and architectural competitions
  • Supervision of B-plan procedures
  • Management of negotiations for urban development contracts
  • Supervision of neighborhood agreements
  • Processing of internal and external reporting


Your profile

  • You have a degree in architecture, civil engineering, real estate management/property management or urban planning or comparable training, e.g. in the field of housing/property management
  • Several years of professional experience in the development of commercial and residential construction projects and building land development
  • Experience in leading project teams
  • Strong communication skills, assertiveness and negotiation skills
  • Legal knowledge of the real estate industry an advantage


Why us?

  • Personal development opportunities in a growing group of companies  
  • Diverse tasks in a motivated team with creative freedom
  • Flexible and family-friendly working hours  
  • Cooperation with pme Familienservice  
  • Training and further education opportunities  
  • 28 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off work
  • BVG company ticket subsidized by the employer
  • Workplace in a central location with lounge area, table tennis and foosball table
  • Fresh fruit, sweets, coffee, water and more
